title: Calls that return scalars and one array
summary: Runs a call whose result is scalars followed by one array, possibly an array of records, that consumes some live temporaries, and ends a composite function that returns such a value.
premises: An Implements theorem for the callee, whose result type has a OneArray instance
Live with the consumed temporaries first
The arguments evaluate to values that represent the callee's input, whose moves are exactly the consumed temporaries' pointers and whose reads lie apart from their blocks
The result locals can hold the scalars and the pointer
result: Live with the result's array at the head of the temporaries in place of the consumed ones, and the state after setting the result locals; at the end of a body, the postcondition of Func.implements_moves.
